annotations.title: IQ Investment Committee seats on one ETF

description: How each seat of the IQ Investment Committee reads one ETF: 11 seats named for investing philosophies (Bogle-style Low Cost, Graham-style Margin of Safety and the others) and the ETFIQ Skeptic, each with its state (Supports, Mixed, Challenges or Not enough data), how much of the seat could be measured, and each criterion's state. States are never a call to buy, sell or hold, and every answer carries the disclosure to show with it. Each seat links its own page, which gives the investor's published source and the thresholds.
